DECLARE @v_date DATE, @max_date DATE, @data_layer VARCHAR(10), @task_name VARCHAR(255)
SET @v_date = '2024-08-02'
SET @task_name = 'TSK_CI_DEP_TRAN_RETAIL'

SELECT @max_date = MAX(TRAN_DATE) FROM EDS.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE;
SELECT @data_layer = DATA_LAYER FROM OM.OM_TASKS WHERE TASK_NAME = @task_name;

IF (@v_date > @max_date )
    BEGIN
        DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'SELECTED DATE IS NOT YET AVAILABLE, CURRENT LATEST DATE IS '+convert(varchar,@max_date)+' IN EDS.DEP_HISTTRANDTLTABLE.';   

        EXEC OM.SP_LOG_TASK_ERROR_DTL NULL, @task_name, @data_layer, @v_date, @errmsg1;
    
	    THROW 50000, @errmsg1, 1;  
    END

SELECT COLUMN_NAME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'EDS' AND TABLE_NAME = 'DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP' ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION

SELECT DISTINCT AS_OF_DATE
    -- AAS.AS_OF_DATE
    --,AAS.ACID
    --,AAS.BANK_ID
    --,CUST.ORGKEY
FROM EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP AAS
INNER JOIN EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
    ON AAS.AS_OF_DATE BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
    AND AAS.CUST_ID = CUST.CORE_CUST_ID
    AND CUSTOMER_TYPE = 'Retail'
WHERE AAS.DEL_FLG <> 'Y'

    '2024-08-01' AS_OF_DATE,ACID,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM,ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE,ACCT_POA_AS_NAME,ACCT_POA_AS_DESIG,ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS,ACCT_POA_AS_AMT_ALWD,START_DATE,END_DATE,LCHG_USER_ID,LCHG_TIME,RCRE_USER_ID,RCRE_TIME,CUST_ID,CUST_RELTN_CODE,PASS_SHEET_FLG,SI_FLG,TD_MATRTY_FLG,LOAN_OVRDUE_FLG,NMA_KEY_TYPE,NMA_KEY_ID,DEL_FLG,MODE_OF_DESPATCH,TS_CNT,SCHM_TYPE,XCLUDE_FOR_COMB_STMT,STMT_CUST_ID,INT_ADV_FLG,INTCERT_PRINT_FLG,GUARANTOR_LIAB_PCNT,GUARANTOR_LIAB_SEQ,INTRADAY_STMNT_REQD,BANK_ID,CUST_PHONE_TYPE,CUST_EMAIL_TYPE,RELATED_PARTY_TYPE,PROFIT_CERT_FLG,PREF_LANG_CODE,PREF_LANG_ACCT_POA_AS_RMKS,ALT1_ACCT_POA_AS_NAME,RPARTY_STMT_PRNT_CHRG_FLG,RPARTY_RGLR_STMT_CHRG_ID,RPARTY_DUP_STMT_CHRG_ID,WTAX_NOTICE_RCV_DATE,WTAX_WAIVER_START_DATE,WTAX_WAIVER_END_DATE,TAX_CERT_NUM,TAX_FORM_PARTICULARS,TAX_CERT_SUBMISSION_DATE,ENTITY_CRE_FLG,TAX_EVENT,REQUESTED_BY,TAX_EVENT_REASON_CODE,TAX_MARKER,CORP_REP_CIF_ID,MINOR_MAJOR_LET_GEN_FLG,CHNGD_DUE_TO_ASSUMPTN_FLG,REASON_FOR_RELEASE,isActive,isLatest,BNK_CODE,SOURCE_CODE,FILE_NAME,insert_dttm
